question: What supported recovery contract should apply when `socket.drain` cannot be queued for a slow Gateway client?
rationale: The patch currently trades loss of one lifecycle frame for loss of the entire connection; source evidence establishes the consequences but cannot determine the intended public protocol policy.

options.title: Disconnect and resync
options.body: Close the overloaded connection with an explicit recoverable reason and require reconnect plus authoritative session-state resynchronization.

options.title: Drop and reconcile
options.body: Use normal frame shedding and require clients to periodically reconcile session state for eventual correctness.

options.title: Bounded priority delivery
options.body: Introduce a separately bounded lifecycle-event path with an explicit overflow fallback.

recommendation.title: Disconnect and resync
recommendation.body: Close the overloaded connection with an explicit recoverable reason and require reconnect plus authoritative session-state resynchronization.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent work owns the shared session-event projection and session lifecycle notification path most directly affected by this decision.
